name: Bored Wife
source:
Mrs. Moore, an ordinary housewife, finds herself in a situation where her life seems monotonous and tiresome. She feels the invisible chains of family responsibilities, and it seems to her that she has lost herself in the routine. And then, one day, she is secretly offered a unique opportunity to change her life.
